title: The Azure Moment Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine of the single blue moment in which the student sees the next blow as an outline and holds the foe still before it falls.

title: The Twin Court Interval Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine for two cultivators who keep their moments in step so that the gap between them seals the foe and quickens both of them.

title: The Oath-Bound Tempo Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine of tempo held by oath in which every ally who swears is quickened and every foe who stands against the oath is held.

title: The Unwalled Span Doctrine
summary: A school doctrine of a long span of time held open with no wall about it where the formed core cuts and mends and cleanses in plain air.
